text.description_html:
First Impressions Contemporary 6.5" x 3" Rectangular Door Pull

These bold 6.5 inch pulls can be used for refrigerator doors, entry doors, commercial doors, or shower doors, and are available back to back, thru-bolt or surface mounted.

This Rectangular Door Pull is available in other sizes and finishes, Contact Us for more information.

Impeccably crafted from high grade 1/2" wide aluminum in your choice of 6 high quality, long lasting finish choices.

Specifications: of First Impressions Rectangular Door Pull

  • Height: 6.5"
  • Width: 3"
  • Projection: 2"

Note: This decorative door handle is handmade in the USA when you order it—allowing it to be custom designed to fit your specific door application, including Other Lengths. Unfortunately, because of the made-to-order nature of the door handle, it is Not Returnable. Please Contact Us with your requirements or if you have any questions.

Packaged Standard with Thrubolt mounting (Bolts thru the door). Optional Surface mounting or Back to Back mounting available (Pulls bolt to each other - Requires 2 door pulls).

*Sold individually.
